capabilities: Render ABC notation as sheet music with audio playback, highlighting, and MIDI export
Create bar, line, scatter, pie, sankey, and other charts via YAML DSL or Observable Plot JavaScript
Embed interactive Leaflet maps with markers, shapes, GeoJSON layers, and custom tile servers
Draw zoomable, pannable event timelines with category filters and SVG export
Insert inline popover comments with ::cmt syntax that print cleanly
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS style plugin; it renders code blocks into charts, music, timelines, maps, and inline comment popovers.
extras: The README lists many supported libraries (abcjs, Leaflet, Observable Plot, D3, chroma-js); JavaScript plot blocks can fetch CSV/JSON files from the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render music notation, data charts, zoomable timelines, or interactive maps from Markdown code blocks inside notes.

relations.evidence: Some code in the simple chart rendering part and settings page are adapted from here

summary: Code-block toolkit that turns abc, chart/plot, timeline, and map blocks into sheet music players, charts, zoomable timelines, and interactive maps.
